messages:
maya: urgent — canary degradation in eu-west1 for r-20260321. 5% canary -> 5xx rate jumped to ~12% over last 10m. https://redwood.logs/178999 — need pin or rollback ASAP :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Canary report for r-20260321-eu
status: degraded
5xx_rate: 12%
latency_p50: 120ms -> 350ms
suggested_actions: rollback_to r-20260315-v2.0 OR pin and ramp older variant

alex: are there DB/migration concerns with rolling back to v2.0?

sara: no migrations. v2.0 is binary compatible for serving. customersafe.

ben: ops — can you carry out a fast rollback/pin? @oncall-ryan

oncall-ryan: I can run it. Need explicit owner approval to proceed (for audit). Maya, please confirm.

maya: I approve. prefer pin-to-v2.0 + gradual ramp. start 20% -> monitor 10m -> 50% -> full. keep canary metrics on.

maya: command I'd like executed:

```
/deploy pin --image r-20260315-v2.0 --region eu-west1 --start-percent 20 --ramp-to 100 --ramp-interval 10m
```

alex: sg. also post quick release note & incident stub: https://docs.redwood/status/drafts/178999

deploy-bot: Received pin request from maya. Kicking off operation: pin_id=pin-178999-01

deploy-bot: pin step 1: routing 20% -> OK

sara: monitoring dashboards — 5xx dropping to 1.2% on the first minute, latency p50 back to 130ms :thumbsup:

ben: approving expedited sign-off for rollout. I'll file the release note and add to changelog.

oncall-ryan: ramping to 50% now (manual). Watching errors/latency.

deploy-bot: ramp to 50% completed. health: degraded->recovering. 5xx 1.1% -> 0.9% over 5m.

maya: hold at 50% for 15m then finish if stable. ops, if 5xx > 2% at any point, rollback immediately.

ben: noted. posting external-facing note now. https://status.redwood.com/incidents/178999

sara: leaving postmortem/issue linked: https://redwood.pager/issues/178999

maya: thanks team. tagging for post-deploy checks and release notes. closing thread after final ramp success.

alex: final ramp to 100% complete at 1789990300. No further abnormal metrics. Marking as resolved.

deploy-bot: Operation pin-178999-01 completed at 1789990300. audits: /a/ops/pin-178999-01
